jobs.title: Direct-to-Consumer Channels Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume di marketing, digitale e commerciale per unire il nostro marchio di viaggio di lusso di nuova creazione Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera.

Il tuo impatto

- L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare gli investimenti di marketing full-funnel in modo olistico, massimizzare l'impatto dei ricavi e l'ottimizzazione ROI sui mercati. Questo ruolo è responsabile dell'analisi delle prestazioni attraverso il viaggio del cliente — dalla consapevolezza attraverso la lealtà — per identificare le opportunità di crescita, migliorare l'efficienza di marketing e guidare i risultati commerciali attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati.
Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni di marketing contro i KPI di marca e commerciali, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per un miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI di marketing chiave attraverso touchpoint (tutti i canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati), le campagne e le prestazioni del pubblico.

- Efficienza dell'azionamento, quantificando ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA per campagna, touchpoint e pubblico per ogni mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomandare reinvestimenti verso attività ad alto impatto, per colpire obiettivi di sensibilizzazione e ricavi.

- Costruisci e mantieni i segnapunti full-funnel per mercato (consapevolezza → considerazione → conversione → lealtà) per identificare i colli di bottiglia di reddito e ottimizzare l'allocazione di bilancio tra i mercati. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI).

- Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione (ad esempio mix media, attribuzione multi-touch) per chiarire il contributo delle entrate attraverso le piattaforme e migliorare l'efficienza degli investimenti.

- Partner di Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue team per prevedere impatti di investimento e allineare le attività di marketing con risultati commerciali.

- Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita.

- Preparare presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi di marketing, analisi commerciali, business intelligence o analisi di marketing delle prestazioni.

- Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza.

- Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita).

I tuoi essenziali

- Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo contemporaneamente più priorità.

- Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili.

- Eccellente in Excel e confortevole manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione

- eccezionali competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite.

- Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti BI e di visualizzazione come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili.

- Conoscenza delle metodologie di misura di marketing, tra cui la modellazione dell'attribuzione, la modellazione dei media, la segmentazione dei clienti e l'analisi ROI.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Ihr Ziel

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die sich im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorstellt. Diese Rolle ist für die Analyse der Leistung auf der gesamten Customer Journey – vom Bewusstsein über Loyalität – verantwortlich, um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren, die Marketingeffizienz zu verbessern und kommerzielle Ergebnisse durch datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung zu erzielen.

Besitzen Sie die Entwicklung, das Tracking und die Action von Key Marketing KPIs über Touchpoint (alle bezahlten, im Besitz befindlichen und erworbenen Kanäle), Kampagnen und Publikumsperformance.

- Antriebseffizienz, Quantifizierung von ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA durch Kampagne, Touchpoint und Publikum für jeden Markt, um Investitionen kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Empfehlen Sie Reinvestitionen zu höchster Wirkung, um die Zielvorgaben für das Bewusstsein und die Einnahmen zu treffen.

- Errichten und pflegen Sie Vollfunnel-Performance-Scorecards auf dem Markt (Awareness → Berücksichtigung → Conversion → Treue), um Umsatzengpässe zu identifizieren und die Budgetzuweisung zwischen den Märkten zu optimieren. Sowohl bei Excel als auch bei der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Unternehmensteam, um es in Self-serve-Tools (Power BI) zur Verfügung zu stellen.

- Entwicklung von Zuteilungsmodellen (z.B. Medienmix, Multi-Touch-Beitrag) zur Klärung des Umsatzbeitrags auf Plattformen und zur Verbesserung der Investitionseffizienz.

- Partner bei Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue Teams, um Investitionsauswirkungen zu prognostizieren und Marketingaktivitäten mit kommerziellen Ergebnissen auszurichten.

- Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics oder ähnlichen Plattformen sowie BI- und Visualisierungstools wie Tableau, Power BI, Looker oder ähnliche Plattformen.

- Kenntnisse der Marketing-Meßmethoden einschließlich Zuschreibungsmodellierung, Medienmixmodellierung, Kundensegmentierung und ROI-Analyse.

- Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Fluent auf Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, ständig über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Reisebranche zu erfahren.

Bei Explora Journeys erneuern wir Luxus-Seereise – wo Entdeckung, Wohlbefinden und ein tiefer Respekt für die Meere in Harmonie zusammenkommen.
Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Fachleute, die unsere Vision einer immersiven, transformativen Art teilen, um die inspirierendsten Ziele der Welt auf dem Meer zu entdecken.
Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns bei Explora Journeys, wo ein Ozean der Möglichkeiten erwartet. Hier beginnt Ihre Reise in den Ocean State of Mind.

Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante s'offre à un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec une forte acuité marketing, numérique et commerciale pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Votre impact

- L'objectif du rôle est d'optimiser globalement les investissements de marketing en plein air, en maximisant l'impact des revenus et l'optimisation du ROI sur les marchés. Ce rôle est chargé d'analyser les performances tout au long du parcours client — de la sensibilisation à la loyauté — pour identifier les possibilités de croissance, améliorer l'efficacité de la commercialisation et stimuler les résultats commerciaux par la prise de décisions fondées sur les données.
Analyse des performances: suivre et analyser les performances de commercialisation par rapport aux KPI commerciaux et de marque, fournissant des informations et des recommandations pour l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux KPI marketing à travers le point de contact (tous les canaux payés, propriétaires et gagnés), les campagnes et la performance du public.

- Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par campagne, point de contact et audience pour chaque marché afin d'optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des activités à impact le plus élevé, pour atteindre des objectifs de sensibilisation et de revenus.

- Construisez et maintenez des fiches de performance full-funnel par marché (conscience → considération → conversion → fidélité) pour identifier les goulots d'étranglement et optimiser l'allocation budgétaire entre les marchés. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI).

- Élaborer des modèles d'attribution (p. ex. mélange de médias, attribution multi-touch) pour clarifier la contribution des recettes sur les différentes plateformes et améliorer l'efficacité des investissements.

- S'associer avec les responsables du marketing et du numérique, les équipes des finances, du commerce et du revenu pour prévoir les impacts sur l'investissement et aligner les activités de marketing sur les résultats commerciaux.

- Analyse concurrentielle : surveiller les conditions du marché, les activités concurrentielles et les tendances de l'industrie pour appuyer la planification stratégique et identifier les possibilités de différenciation et de croissance.

- Préparer des présentations prêtes pour les cadres supérieurs, avec des recommandations claires fondées sur des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques des cadres supérieurs, en tirant parti de la visualisation des données stellaires combinée à la profondeur des idées.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'analyse marketing, l'analyse commerciale, l'intelligence d'affaires ou l'analyse marketing performance.

- préférence pour l'expérience antérieure dans l'hôtellerie de luxe/l'industrie du voyage ou les agences de conseil.

- Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée).

Vos essentiels

- Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, en gérant simultanément plusieurs priorités.

- Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en informations opérationnelles exploitables.

- Hautement compétent en Excel et confortable manipulant les données des grands ensembles de données et conservant de grands tableurs avec un haut niveau de précision

- Excellentes compétences en PowerPoint et en narration – capables d'élaborer des présentations propres, nettes et à impact élevé pour les auditoires C-suite.

- Expérience de travail avec Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes similaires, ainsi que des outils BI et de visualisation tels que Tableau, Power BI, Looker ou des plateformes similaires.

- Connaissance des méthodes de mesure de la commercialisation, y compris la modélisation de l'attribution, la modélisation de la combinaison des médias, la segmentation de la clientèle et l'analyse du ROI.

- Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale. En anglais.

- Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement l'industrie du voyage en constante évolution.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.
Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo

La Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing e CRO Manager saranno responsabili della crescita del D2C attraverso la sperimentazione basata sui dati e l'ottimizzazione strategica dei nostri canali digitali diretti. Potrai testare la nostra strategia di test e approfondimenti per massimizzare i tassi di conversione, la prenotazione di volumi e ricavi per visitatore, mentre la costruzione di una pratica di sperimentazione migliore in classe che offre un vantaggio competitivo sostenibile. Questo ruolo avrà una forte attenzione strategica sul canale diretto, ottimizzando la generazione di piombo, e sfruttando intuizioni per guidare l'acquisizione, l'impegno e il valore di vita del cliente più elevato.

Il tuo impatto

• Progettare ed eseguire una strategia globale basata sui dati in tutti i punti di contatto digitali, con particolare attenzione alla guida della crescita dei canali diretti e alla riduzione dei costi di acquisizione attraverso un miglioramento dei tassi di conversione.

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali tra cui prodotti, design, ingegneria, marketing e analisi web per concettualizzare e progettare test A/B che misurano efficacemente l'impatto dei cambiamenti del sito web e della campagna.

• Guidare iniziative strategiche all'interno del canale diretto, garantendo un approccio basato sui dati per la generazione di lead, la segmentazione del pubblico e l'ottimizzazione del customer journey per migliorare la conversione e l'impegno.

• Sviluppare approfondimenti di viaggio dei clienti attraverso analisi avanzate, identificare punti di attrito chiave e opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza degli utenti e guidare valori di prenotazione più elevati.

• Eseguire analisi di segmentazione digitale avanzate per scoprire segmenti di clienti di alto valore e opportunità di personalizzazione attraverso l'imbuto di conversione.

• Stabilire strutture di misura robuste per quantificare l'impatto commerciale delle iniziative di ottimizzazione, tra cui la progettazione di test, la previsione dei ricavi e l'analisi post-implementazione.

• Sviluppa dashboard di prestazioni complete che combinano i risultati dei test, le metriche del comportamento del cliente e i KPI commerciali per guidare l'ottimizzazione dei tassi di conversione.

• Guidare l'innovazione nelle strategie di personalizzazione e ottimizzazione per massimizzare il contributo diretto dei canali utilizzando gli strumenti di nuova adozione (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Sviluppare framework di test che bilanciano rapidamente le vincite con iniziative strategiche a lungo termine.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• Laurea in business, marketing, analisi o un campo relativo, con 5 anni di esperienza rilevante.

• Provato track record di sfruttare intuizioni di dati D2C per modellare le strategie di marketing e di prodotto, in particolare nella prenotazione di ottimizzazione deimbuti.

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti di test A/B come Adobe Target.

I tuoi essenziali

• Competenza in piattaforme di analisi web come Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics e AEP.

• Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di distillare dati complessi in strategie aziendali attuabili.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente tra i team e influenzare il processo decisionale.

• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione, gestendo più iniziative contemporaneamente.

• Passaporto UE o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Votre impact

• Concevoir et exécuter une stratégie globale axée sur les données dans tous les points de contact numériques, en mettant l'accent sur la croissance des canaux directs et la réduction des coûts d'acquisition grâce à l'amélioration des taux de conversion.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles comprenant des produits, la conception, l'ingénierie, le marketing et l'analyse web pour conceptualiser et concevoir des tests A/B qui mesurent efficacement l'impact des changements de site Web et de campagne.

• Diriger les initiatives stratégiques au sein du canal direct, en assurant une approche axée sur les données pour la production de pointe, la segmentation du public et l'optimisation du parcours client pour améliorer la conversion et l'engagement.

• Développer des connaissances approfondies sur le parcours client grâce à des analyses avancées, en identifiant les points de friction clés et les opportunités pour améliorer l'expérience utilisateur et conduire des valeurs de réservation plus élevées.

• Effectuer des analyses de segmentation numérique avancées pour découvrir des segments de clients de grande valeur et des possibilités de personnalisation à travers l'entonnoir de conversion.

The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). Financial Management & Reporting

- Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Vice President Global SPA and Wellness is the global business owner for all onboard SPA, wellness, beauty, and fitness operations across the Cruise Division of MSC Group, spanning MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) and Explora Journeys (Luxury).

The role has full accountability for SPA and treatment programs, fitness and thermal areas, salon services, wellness retail, medical aesthetics (where applicable), and future digital wellness offerings.

This position ensures that luxury wellness standards, service rituals, therapeutic excellence, and holistic wellbeing philosophies are fully embedded—particularly for Explora Journeys—while maintaining scalable, brand-differentiated wellness frameworks across the fleet.

The VP defines the long-term global SPA and wellness vision, drives commercial performance, elevates guest satisfaction, and evolves wellness concepts that differentiate MSC Group’s Cruise Division across contemporary, premium, and luxury segments.

Your Impact

Strategic & Commercial Leadership

- Define and lead the global SPA and wellness strategy across contemporary, premium, and luxury brands, aligned with differentiated guest profiles and brand positioning.

- Act as business owner for Global SPA and Wellness, with explicit accountability for luxury wellness concepts and standards.

- Own the end-to-end commercial roadmap, including treatment architecture, pricing strategy, promotions, capacity optimisation, and end-to-end guest journey design.

- Lead strategic negotiations with SPA operators, wellness partners, medical aesthetics providers (where permitted), product brands, and equipment suppliers.

- Drive growth in high-margin and premium wellness categories, including signature treatments, medical aesthetics, fitness and longevity programs, wellness retail, and personalised wellbeing journeys.

- Develop scalable yet brand-distinct SPA and wellness frameworks, enabling selective deployment of premium and luxury concepts across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

Operational and Brand Excellence

- Oversee SPA operations fleet-wide, ensuring consistent service delivery, treatment quality, hygiene standards, and guest satisfaction.

- Define service standards, therapist certification requirements, training programs, and performance benchmarks across all SPA formats.

- Ensure luxury wellness excellence for Explora Journeys, including service rituals, therapist conduct, holistic programming, privacy standards, and immersive wellness environments.

- Introduce tier-specific wellness concepts, signature and luxury rituals, experiential programming, and destination-inspired treatments.

- Ensure fleet readiness for newbuilds and dry docks, including SPA layout design, equipment selection, CAPEX planning, and concept activation.

Financial Management

- Own the full P&L for SPA and Wellness across all Cruise Division brands, including annual budgets, revenue targets, margin improvement, and cost control.

- Optimise therapist productivity, treatment mix, pricing discipline, retail attachment rates, staffing models, and concession economics.

- Leverage advanced analytics to drive demand forecasting, yield management, guest segmentation, booking optimisation, and treatment performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance, and Newbuild teams to integrate wellness into the overall guest experience.

- Collaborate with CRM and Digital teams on pre-cruise wellness engagement, onboard booking optimisation, and personalised wellness journeys.

- Align SPA offerings with itinerary, destination, and onboard programming to maximise relevance differentiation, and revenue.

Leadership & Organisational Development

- Lead a global HQ and fleet SPA and wellness organisation, including strategy, operations, training, and partner management teams.

- Build a culture of guest-centric service excellence, luxury wellness stewardship, commercial discipline, and continuous innovation.

- Mentor senior leaders and strengthen capabilities across SPA operations, luxury wellness concept development, and data-driven performance management.

Your Journey so far

- 15+ years senior leadership experience in SPA, wellness, hospitality, cruise, or multi-site service businesses.

- Proven success owning complex P&Ls and driving profitability in service-led environments.

- Deep expertise in SPA operations, wellness programming, service quality management, and luxury guest experience standards.

- Strong experience managing third-party operators, concession models, or global vendor partnerships.

Your Essentials

- Excellent leadership, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

- Willingness to travel extensively and operate in a fast-paced international environment.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il Vice President Global SPA and Wellness è il proprietario di business globale per tutte le operazioni di SPA, benessere, bellezza e fitness a bordo della Divisione Crociera di MSC Group, che comprende MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) e Explora Journeys (Luxury).

Il ruolo ha piena responsabilità per i programmi SPA e di trattamento, aree fitness e termali, servizi di salone, vendita al dettaglio benessere, estetica medica (dove applicabile), e future offerte di benessere digitale.

Questa posizione garantisce che gli standard di lusso per il benessere, i rituali di servizio, l'eccellenza terapeutica e le filosofie olistiche per il benessere siano completamente incorporati, in particolare per Explora Journeys, pur mantenendo ambienti benessere scalabili e differenziati dal marchio in tutta la flotta.

Il VP definisce la visione globale di SPA e benessere a lungo termine, spinge le prestazioni commerciali, eleva la soddisfazione degli ospiti, ed evolve concetti di benessere che differenziano la Divisione Crociera di MSC Group attraverso segmenti contemporanei, premium e di lusso.

Leadership strategica e commerciale

- Agire come proprietario di business per Global SPA e Wellness, con responsabilità esplicita per i concetti e gli standard di lusso.

- Proprio la roadmap commerciale end-to-end, tra cui l'architettura del trattamento, la strategia dei prezzi, le promozioni, l'ottimizzazione della capacità e la progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti end-to-end.

- Crescita dell'azionamento in categorie di benessere ad alto livello e premium, tra cui trattamenti firma, estetica medica, programmi di fitness e longevità, vendita al dettaglio di benessere e viaggi di benessere personalizzati.

- Sviluppare framework SPA e wellness scalabili ma distinguibili, consentendo la distribuzione selettiva di concetti premium e di lusso attraverso MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys.

Eccellenza operativa e di marca

- Superare le operazioni SPA a livello di flotta, assicurando la fornitura di servizi coerenti, la qualità del trattamento, gli standard igienici e la soddisfazione degli ospiti.

- Definire standard di servizio, requisiti di certificazione terapeutica, programmi di formazione e benchmark di prestazioni in tutti i formati SPA.

- Assicurare l'eccellenza del benessere di lusso per i viaggi Explora, inclusi rituali di servizio, condotta terapeutica, programmazione olistica, norme sulla privacy e ambienti benessere immersivi.

- Introdurre concetti di benessere specifici, rituali di firma e lusso, programmazione esperienziale e trattamenti ispirati alla destinazione.

- Assicurare la disponibilità della flotta per nuove costruzioni e banchine a secco, tra cui progettazione di layout SPA, selezione di attrezzature, pianificazione CAPEX e attivazione del concetto.

Gestione finanziaria

- Possedere la P&L completa per SPA e Wellness in tutti i marchi della Divisione Crociera, inclusi budget annui, target di ricavi, miglioramento dei margini e controllo dei costi.

- Ottimizzare la produttività del terapeuta, il mix di trattamento, la disciplina dei prezzi, i tassi di attaccamento al dettaglio, i modelli di personale e l'economia di concessione.

- Leva analisi avanzate per guidare la previsione della domanda, la gestione dei rendimenti, la segmentazione degli ospiti, l'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni e le prestazioni del trattamento.

Collaborazione trasversale

- Partner a stretto contatto con i team Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance e Newbuild per integrare il benessere nell'esperienza complessiva degli ospiti.

- Collabora con i team CRM e Digital nell'impegno pre-cruise wellness, nell'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni a bordo e nei viaggi di benessere personalizzati.

- Allineare le offerte SPA con itinerario, destinazione e programmazione a bordo per massimizzare la differenziazione di rilevanza e le entrate.

Leadership & Sviluppo organizzativo

- Guidare un QQ globale e la flotta SPA e l'organizzazione benessere, tra cui team di strategia, operazioni, formazione e gestione dei partner.

- Costruisci una cultura dell'eccellenza del servizio guest-centric, della gestione del benessere di lusso, della disciplina commerciale e dell'innovazione continua.

- Mentor senior leader e rafforzare le capacità tra le operazioni SPA, lo sviluppo del concetto di benessere di lusso e la gestione delle prestazioni guidata dai dati.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Proven successo proprietario di P&L complessi e la redditività di guida in ambienti orientati al servizio.

- Profonda competenza nelle operazioni SPA, programmazione del benessere, gestione della qualità dei servizi e standard di esperienza degli ospiti di lusso.

- Forte esperienza nella gestione di operatori di terze parti, modelli di concessione, o partnership di fornitori globali.

- Besitzen Sie die end-to-end-kommerzielle Roadmap, einschließlich Behandlungsarchitektur, Preisstrategie, Promotions, Kapazitätsoptimierung und End-to-End-Gastreise-Design.

- Führen Sie strategische Verhandlungen mit SPA-Betreibern, Wellness-Partnern, medizinischen Ästhetik-Anbietern (sofern zulässig), Produktmarken und Geräteanbietern.

Betriebs- und Markenexzellenz

- Beaufsichtigen Sie die SPA-Operationen flottenweit und gewährleisten Sie eine konsequente Service-Lieferung, Behandlungsqualität, Hygienestandards und Gästezufriedenheit.

- Definieren Sie Service-Standards, therapistische Zertifizierungsanforderungen, Schulungsprogramme und Leistungs-Benchmarks in allen SPA-Formaten.

- Vergewissern Sie sich Luxus-Wellness-Exzellenz für Explora Journeys, einschließlich Service Rituale, Therapeutenverhalten, ganzheitliche Programmierung, Datenschutzstandards und immersive Wellness-Umgebungen.

- Optimieren Sie die Produktivität der Therapeuten, den Behandlungsmix, die Preisdisziplin, die Anpassungsraten des Einzelhandels, die Personalmodelle und die Konzessionsökonomie.

- Leverage fortschrittliche Analytik, um Nachfrageprognosen, Ertragsmanagement, Gastsegmentierung, Buchungsoptimierung und Behandlungsleistung zu steigern.

- Starke Erfahrung bei der Verwaltung von Drittanbietern, Konzessionsmodellen oder globalen Anbieterpartnerschaften.

- Ausgezeichnete Führungs-, Verhandlungs- und funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder Managementfähigkeiten.

- Bereitschaft, umfassend zu reisen und in einem rasanten internationalen Umfeld zu betreiben.

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. jobs.title: Mobile App Product Specialist
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) :

- Right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?

Supporto strategico e partenariato di pensiero

Strategische Unterstützung und Gedankenpartnerschaft

- Bereiten Sie strategische Briefe, Entscheidungsrahmen und Synthesedokumente für SVP-Level-Konversationen vor.

- Transformieren Sie komplexe Informationen in hochwirksame Erzählungen.

- Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf SVP/EVP/Executive Committee Diskussionen.

- Starker Hintergrund bei der Gestaltung und Durchführung von Gast-fokussierten Erfahrungen, vom Konzept bis zur Lieferung.

- Starke Storytelling- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, mit Vertrauen auf Executive-Ebene.

- Fähigkeit, 20-30% der Zeit zu reisen.

- Fluent English; weitere Sprachen a plus.

Ihre Essenzen

- Effizienz in Excel, PowerPoint und Outlook.

- EU-Pass oder Arbeitsrecht in der Schweiz.

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

- Expérience opérationnelle et de gestion au sein de l'industrie du divertissement.

Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B.

Strategic Operations & Standards

- Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices.

- Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels.

- Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards.

- Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence.

Guest Experience & Quality Assurance

- Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements.

- Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering.

- Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs.

Training & Leadership Development

- Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy.

- Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning.

Human Resources & Leadership Oversight

- Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel.

- Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness.

- Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet.

- Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership.

- Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required.

Financial Oversight

- Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet.

- Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams.

- Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems.

- Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards.

- Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards.

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Parte del team di Marketing globale e riportando direttamente al Brand Director, questo ruolo svolge un ruolo centrale nella salvaguardia, nella modellazione e nell'attivazione del marchio Explora Journeys in tutti i punti di contatto, con una particolare attenzione alle campagne di marca, alla flotta e ai nuovi sviluppi del marchio.

Situato nella nostra sede di Ginevra, questo ruolo si trova all'intersezione della strategia di marca, della narrazione dei prodotti e dell'esecuzione, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media e Digital per portare il marchio alla vita con chiarezza, consistenza e profondità emotiva, attraverso i mercati.

Il tuo impatto

Gestione e Governance dei marchi

- Agire come tutore principale del marchio Explora Journeys, supportando il Brand Director nella gestione quotidiana, nello sviluppo e nell'evoluzione del marchio.

- Assicurare l'applicazione coerente di identità di marca, tono di voce, messaggistica e linguaggio visivo in tutti i punti di contatto, canali e viaggi degli ospiti.

- Condurre lo sviluppo, l'evoluzione e la manutenzione delle linee guida, dei framework e dei toolkit master, garantendo rilevanza, chiarezza e scalabilità a livello globale.

- Monitorare l'esecuzione del marchio su mercati e partner, identificare proattivamente le incongruenze e lavorare in collaborazione con gli stakeholder per salvaguardare gli standard di lusso e ospitalità.

- Contribuire a iniziative di strategia di marca, progetti di evoluzione del marchio e formazione interna del marchio, rafforzare la comprensione e l'allineamento del marchio in tutta l'organizzazione.

Campagne, contenuti e attività di marca

- Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di campagne di master brand e prodotti, in linea con la strategia del marchio e le priorità commerciali.

- Superare la creazione di eroi e beni di prodotto, tra cui visivi chiave, quadri di copia, brochure, fotografia e videografia.

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Media, Digital e PR per garantire un'espressione coerente e premium del marchio attraverso canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati.

- Gestire e curare i contenuti di marca, prodotto e flotta all'interno dei sistemi DAM e PIM, garantendo precisione, facilità d'uso e adozione di mercato globale.

Marketing del prodotto – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Possedere e articolare la narrazione del marchio e del prodotto per la flotta Explora Journeys, traducendo il design delle navi, le esperienze a bordo e la filosofia di servizio in avvincente, chiaro, e guest-centric storytelling.

- Agire come partner chiave del marchio per i team di Product, New Builds e Hotel Operations, supportando progetti in tutto il ciclo di vita della nave; dal concetto iniziale alla consegna, al lancio e all'evoluzione in-service.

- Definire e attivare proposizioni e concetti a livello di nave, esperienze a bordo, concetti suite, pilastri culinari, benessere e vendita al dettaglio, e rituali di servizio.

- Assicurare l'allineamento tra l'esperienza ospite a bordo e la promessa del marchio comunicata al mercato.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Supporto del marchio e prontezza del prodotto per nuove iniziative di marca, campagne, lanci delle navi, grandi pietre miliari e innovazioni a bordo.

- Sviluppare strumenti di lancio master per dotare canali, mercati, vendite e PR con chiare narrazioni, posizionamento e attività.

- Assicurare coerenza, chiarezza e allineamento del marchio in tutte le comunicazioni interne ed esterne relative a marca, flotta ed evoluzione del prodotto.

Collaborazione funzionale e eccellenza operativa

- Agire come partner di marca di fiducia attraverso le funzioni, promuovendo l'allineamento tra brand, prodotto, commerciale e team operativi

- Coordinare budget, fornitori, previsioni, ordini di acquisto e fatturazione relative alle iniziative di marca.

- Equilibrare il marchio strategico pensando con le mani sull'esecuzione in un ambiente veloce.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea magistrale in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, o in un campo relativo.

- 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del marchio e nella costruzione di campagne.

- Esperienza prioritaria all'interno di lusso, premium o high-end di viaggio, ospitalità o marchi di consumatori fortemente preferito.

- Esperienza comprovata che opera in un ambiente di quartier generale globale, gestione dei quadri di marca e dei beni master in tutti i mercati.

- Esperienza di agenzie di gestione e partner creativi esterni.

I tuoi essenziali

- Esposizione al marketing del prodotto e ai prodotti basati sull'esperienza fisica (ship, hotel, resort o ambienti premium complessi altamente desiderabili).

- Forte sensibilità creativa combinata con rigore operativo, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

- Comodo spostamento tra pensiero strategico del marchio e esecuzione dettagliata.

- Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un forte vantaggio.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Sviluppo della formazione e della leadership

- Minimo 15 anni in operazioni culinarie di fascia alta con competenze avanzate.

- Almeno 5 anni in ruoli di leadership senior all'interno di ospitalità di lusso o operazioni di crociera.

- Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione culinaria a livello di flotta o multi-sito.

I tuoi essenziali

Leadership e comunicazione

- Leader dinamico e strategico con esperienza nella gestione di team multiculturali.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive un bene.

Conoscenza tecnica e operativa
